## Summary

P26.5 — **the vendor tenant universe: full enumeration + remaining platforms**
(ticket `docs/tickets/P26.5__vendor-tenant-universe.md`, SOURCES.5), stacked on
`devin/p26-4-credential-ingests` (PR #96).

P26.3 proved one connector × N tenant hosts is the real expansion multiplier —
but the target list was a curated 76-host seed. This ticket takes the
enumeration to the documented vendor ceiling: **793 registered tenant rows**
across Legistar, CivicClerk, PrimeGov and the newly-discovered **eScribe**,
each carrying a per-row `enum_source` (Common Crawl / certificate-transparency /
crt.sh / Wayback / Census-Gazetteer / platform-probe provenance), plus a
**1,055-row `platform_census`** preserving every enumerated host that is NOT a
target — robots walls, no-bounded-API portals, unreachable hosts, junk slugs —
recorded, never silently dropped.

## What changed

### Registry (data)

- `agenda_tenants.toml`: 76 → **793** `[tenants.*]` rows —
  legistar 306, civicclerk 303, primegov 110, escribe 74 — every row carrying
  `enum_source`; the 76 P26.3 seeds annotated `p26_3_seed`. New
  `[[platform_census]]` (1,055 rows): granicus 434, civicplus 355,
  novusagenda 156, iqm2 57, primegov 30, legistar 12, boarddocs 11.
- `live_targets.toml`: `escribe` → `agenda_tenants` expansion.
- `sources.toml`: `escribe` flipped under GL-GATE-06 (municipal meeting
  records = public records → CC0-1.0; packet
  `docs/build/reports/rights/escribe.md`); `granicus` registered as a gated
  LINK/`not_contacted` discovery row.
- `live_dispositions.toml`: `escribe` row removed (connector-mapped now);
  `granicus` `link_only` row added — the mapped∪disposed completeness rule
  still holds exactly-one-per-source.
- `ops/cadence.toml`: `escribe` monthly row (`sig-ingest-escribe` /
  `sig-sched-escribe`, `0 5 23 * *`); the deployed jobs + triggers were
  applied for real (`scheduled-ops.sh --apply`).

### Code

- `procurement.py`: the platform payload envelope key is now data —
  `items_key` on the reviewed `[platform_endpoints.*]` row (eScribe's
  `{"d":[…]}` webmethod) — plus eScribe field aliases (`ID`, `Guid`,
  `MeetingName`, `MeetingType`, `StartDate`). Same agenda_index/meeting-body
  claims; no new semantics. New `platform_census()` accessor.
- `runner.py`: fixture replay/shadow paths inject a no-real-sleep
  `RateLimiter` — a static transport opens no socket; politeness bookkeeping
  still runs, but 300-target fixture fan-out no longer burns real minutes.
  Live runs unchanged.

### Tests

- `escribe_victoria_meetings.json` fixture + `test_escribe_meetings_index_over_fixture`.
- `test_platform_census_rows_are_enumerated_never_targets` — census hosts can
  never become live targets.
- Review-status/disposition/registry counts updated for 144 registered /
  44 loadable.

## Live verification (2026-09-17, real gated egress)

| source | attempted | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| legistar | 306 | 302 captures → **35,300 claims**; 4 recorded `access_restricted` |
| civicclerk | 303 | 295 captures → **4,415 claims**; 303× robots `no_policy_4xx`; 8 `link_rotted` |
| primegov | 110 | **110 recorded robots refusals** (102 `Disallow: /` + 8 unretrievable) — never bypassed |
| escribe | 74 | 68 captures → **15,508 claims**; 6 recorded `RobotsUnretrievable` refusals |

Deployed-runner runs: Cloud Run jobs `sig-ingest-{legistar,civicclerk,primegov,escribe}`
(executions `-h8rc8`/`-knhrh`/`-4g95x`/`-wdhkw`, image `sha256:1af581d1…`,
linux/amd64) write claims into the hosted spine; WORM run rows under
`gs://zeta-medley-508121-u7-sig-restricted/ops/runs/…`.
Committed fetch records: `docs/build/reports/live_runs/2026-09-17_*_p265.json`.

## Ladder

registered **143 → 144** · permitted/loadable **43 → 44** ·
live-target sources **30 → 31** (agenda tenant targets 76 → **793**) ·
claim-producing **20 → 21**.

## Invariants held

- Per-host robots decided every outcome; `Disallow: /` refused and recorded,
  never bypassed (PrimeGov 110/110).
- ADR-087/RFC 9309: robots 4xx = no policy (CivicClerk 303×, eScribe 18×);
  robots unretrievable = no permission (14 recorded refusals).
- No secrets in files; no person/plate data; append-only spine; the loader
  stays fail-closed.
